data.title: 焰影苇草 · 檐下的距离
data.description: 雨丝被风吹进屋檐，她挪近替你挡住一点，抬眼问有没有淋湿，说话时脸颊微微泛红。
data.action: 檐下靠近，抬眼关切地看向镜头
data.camera: 中近景，人物神态与互动清晰
data.promptProse: Sheltering beneath the stone archway of a rustic shop awning, Reed stands close beside the viewer to avoid the driving drizzle. Rain drops drum steadily from the mossy eaves onto the gleaming cobblestones, while soft misty daylight highlights her flushed cheeks.
data.animaCaption: She steps slightly closer under the narrow stone awning, looking up with flushed cheeks to check whether the viewer is shielded from the rain.
